BrochureContent.Content:
Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer proudly offers for sale this stunning detached bungalow situated in a most convenient rural location just 4km minutes from Carrigaline.

The property enjoys a most peaceful setting on a spacious 0.27 acre site that is directly south facing garden and is beautifully landscaped enjoying wonderful privacy. It offers a nice blend of both living and bedroom accommodation with well proportioned rooms throughout. It will be obvious to anyone who will view this impeccable home, that it has been extremely well cared for and presented for by its current owners both internally and externally. It has beautifully landscaped gardens front and rear that contains mature hedging and shrubbery as well as having a nice cobble-lock driveway with easy access onto the main road. 

The property is perfectly positioned, just a 5 minutes drive to Carrigaline town centre where a host of amenities and services are available and is only a short commute to Kinsale, Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy, all being within a 20 minute drive.

Viewing of this rare opportunity to acquire a lovely home in a most popular rural location comes highly recommended.

Size: 128 sq metres (1,376 sq ft)
Gas Fired Central Heating
PVC Double Glazed Windows & Doors
Beautifully landscaped c.0.27 acre site
South facing rear garden with excellent privacy
Detached Garage
Cobblelock driveway
Minutes drive to Carrigaline town centre
Short commute to Kinsale, Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy

From Carrigaline, continue through the main street and follow the road around to the right passing The Corner House on the right handside. Drive out this road for approximately 500/600metres rounding a bend to the right and take the first right onto the Forest Road. Continue out this road for approximately 3/4km and the property is located on the left handside, indicated by our "For Sale" sign. Follow Eircode: P43 WR40
